usedFor: Developers track errors in FlareApp, and “Create Project” sets up a new project to monitor.

bestTemplate.name: “New Project Created” in ProjectManager, then “Create Project” in FlareApp
bestTemplate.why: A new project elsewhere gets a matching project in FlareApp, so error tracking is ready from the start.

watchOut: Each run of “Create Project” in FlareApp adds a project, so check the trigger before turning a template on.
